name: The Devil
flavour: The Devil deals you in. The desert can smell it a mile off.
text: The Devil deals you in: +25% difficulty a level. Dark variants and elite-marked creatures come more often: tougher, but each pays more XP and may drop a chest.
art_prompt: a small glass bottle of bright red hot sauce with a red screw cap and a cream label showing a red chili pepper, a drop of sauce running down its side

A.note: the icon before the cards (passes 47-72): an object, not a card

B.note: B · tilted card (detail: the least: flat colours, one symbol, nothing else)

recipe.subject: One single fortune-teller tarot card standing upright and tilted about 12 degrees clockwise, filling the picture from top to bottom, seen straight on. The card has a thick cream parchment border with rounded corners and a thin dark brown line just inside it and a black face. One huge bold symbol fills almost the whole face: one huge horned red devil face with a wide toothy grin and glowing yellow eyes, in red, ember orange and black. The symbol is so big it overlaps the border a little. Nothing else on the card: no stars, no landscape, no corner ornaments, no frame lines inside
